about_short_description.short_description: OTO Course is an online digital learning platform that provides online English courses.

product.name: Online English Courses
product.description: OTO Courses offers online English learning sessions with private instructors, tailored to the learner's needs, available 24/7.

product.name: Online Placement Test
product.description: A free online test to assess English proficiency and recommend a suitable course level, based on the CEFR framework.

product.name: Customized and Tailored English Courses
product.description: Courses designed to meet individual learning needs and goals, with content adjusted by the instructor.

product.name: Flexible Scheduling
product.description: Learners can book classes at any time, providing flexibility to fit their schedule.

identifier.value: CEFR Based English Proficiency Score Certificate

product.name: CEFR Based English Proficiency Score Certificate
product.description: Certificates awarded upon course completion, indicating the learner's proficiency level according to the CEFR.

product.name: Basic English Course
product.description: A course for beginners focusing on basic expressions, personal details interaction, and simple communication.
